Welcome to the Quick Exam main menu. 
 Here, you can generate answer sheets and correct them easily and conveniently! 

 • In the first option, you can generate an answer sheet by entering the number of questions and answer choices for your exam. Then, print as many copies as needed for your students.

 • In the second option, you can correct the answer sheet generated in the previous step by simply pointing the Kariti camera at it. The app will automatically correct it and display the result on your screen.

 • At the beginning of each correction session, you’ll be asked to fill in the answer key for your exam. Once completed, all answer sheets based on that key can be corrected in sequence.

The answer sheet must be filled out using a dark-colored pen, preferably black.

In this section, you can generate answer sheets.

 • To generate an answer sheet, simply provide the number of questions and answer choices for your test.

 • Information such as the exam name, class name, teacher name, and date is optional.

 • Once you click on "Generate Card," Kariti will download the answer sheet to your "device's" Downloads folder.

• To continue using Kariti features, select the desired school. 

 • Each school has its own information that is restricted from others. 

 • To deactivate a school, simply select the desired school and confirm the action.

 Later, you can find your deactivated schools by clicking the Deactivated Schools button.

Your Kariti data has been sent to your email.

 Make sure you receive the email before uninstalling Kariti from this device.

• Click on the "Student" option to register your students, regardless of the classes to which they belong. If you do not wish to register the students at this stage, it will be possible to add anonymous students (without a defined name) later.


 • Click on the "Class" option to register student classes and link the corresponding students (anonymous students can also be added at this stage).

 • After registering the class and linking the corresponding students, click on "Test" to enter the information about a test to be applied, including its basic details and answer key.

On this screen, class information can be modified, following the same format used when registering a class.

 1 - Name: If you wish to change the name, simply enter a new one.

 2 - Students: New students can be added to this class by selecting them in the 'Select the Students' field. These students must have already been registered in KARITI on the student registration screen. To remove a student, simply click on their name to remove them from the class.

 3 - Anonymous: If you prefer not to register individual students, you can add anonymous students by entering the desired number in the 'Add Anonymous Students' field, without needing to register any students as described in option 2.

 Note: A class cannot be registered without students.

Exam Menu

 • Register Exam – By selecting this option, you will be redirected to a screen that requests the necessary information for creating the exam, followed by the answer key setup.

 • Generate Answer Sheets – This option allows you to download the answer sheets for an exam previously registered using the option above.

 • Grade Exams – After selecting this option, simply follow the steps suggested by KARITI, point the camera at the answer sheet, and wait for the grading to be completed.

 • View Exams – In this option, you can view the exams and the grading results for each one, if they have already been graded.
